run_kbc_experiment: run a knowledge base completion experiment using KBCEngine with a chosen model and dataset
run_KBCEngine_episode: run the KBCEngine episode method to execute a full training and evaluation cycle
run_TransE_model: run a TransE knowledge graph embedding model on FB15K-237 with LCWA training
run_ComplEx_model: run a ComplEx complex embedding model on WN18RR with Adam optimizer
run_TuckER_model: run a TuckER tensor completion model on ogbl-biokg with custom rank and batch size
